subject: Dedicated cluster evacuation & locality attestation — FinWell
messages:
From: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@finwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finwell.com>, FinWell Security <security@finwell.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Data locality attestation and offboarding playbook for dedicated cluster

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — FinWell's legal and security teams are doing a final review ahead of the PO for the dedicated cluster. Two quick asks we need answered before we sign: 

1) Confirm that our dedicated cluster can be pinned to us-west-2 and that no background cross-region replication is enabled by default. We need an explicit statement about primary data residency and backup placement.

2) If we cancel the contract, what is the documented evacuation/wipe playbook and how long will the entire tenant purge + verification take (including snapshots, object stores, and any backups)? We need chain-of-custody style evidence we can store with our vendor files (audit-export, signed attestation).

3) Are encryption keys customer-managed (BYOK) or managed by Redwood for this mode? If Redwood manages keys, what is the key destruction/rotation policy tied to tenant deletion?

Please send any artifacts you can share (runbook, sample audit export, a draft attestation). We can keep anything sensitive under NDA but it'd help accelerate procurement.

Best,
Alan Tucker
Head of Platform Security
FinWell Financial

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@finwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data locality attestation and offboarding playbook for dedicated cluster

Alan —

Thanks — summarizing answers and attaching a concise runbook for your legal team to review. Important points up front:

- Region pinning: your dedicated pool can be deployed and pinned to us-west-2. By default we do not enable cross-region replication for Dedicated capacity; cross-region snapshots are an opt-in configuration and require a separate replication policy.

- Backup / snapshot placement: snapshots and ephemeral cache persistence for Dedicated are stored in the same region (us-west-2) unless a replication policy is explicitly turned on. We keep 30 days of incremental snapshots by default; retention can be adjusted via contract.

- Evacuation & wipe timeline: typical tenant evacuation (no legal hold) — 48–72 hours for full tenant data purge and sanity verification, 72–120 hours if forensic export and verification steps are required. This includes deleting snapshots, snapshot manifests, object-store objects, and clearing local KV caches.

- Evidence artifacts we can provide: a signed locality attestation, an export of the audit log slice for the relevant tenant (audit-export-YYYYMMDD.json), and a region_pin_manifest.csv showing all pinned resources and their region.

- Keys: For Dedicated we support both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys (BYOK). If you choose BYOK, key rotation and destruction are under your control; if Redwood-managed keys are used, we will follow our documented KMS key lifecycle (rotation every 90 days, deletion only after tenant wipe process completes and with explicit signing). We can include key ID references in the attestation.

I've attached a short runbook (redwood-dedicated-evac-runbook.pdf) — it lists the order of operations, owners, and expected artifacts. Next steps:
  - Can you confirm whether FinWell will require BYOK for the final deployment?
  - If so, Marissa will coordinate a KMS onboarding/validation call and Karthik will validate the snapshot retention policy options with infra.

I attached the runbook and flagged the sections that map to your three asks. If it's helpful, we can provide a small sample audit export (sanitized) for an internal test tenant.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-evac-runbook.pdf (38KB)
From: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@finwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: FinWell Security <security@finwell.com>, Procurement <procurement@finwell.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data locality attestation and offboarding playbook for dedicated cluster

Irene — thanks for the quick response and the runbook. A couple clarifications before we loop legal in: 

- Please confirm explicitly that no cross-region replication is active for our account and that snapshots are only stored in us-west-2 unless we instruct otherwise. We need a one-line confirmation we can put in our vendor assessment.

- Regarding keys: we plan to use BYOK. Can you confirm the BYOK onboarding timeline (how long until keys are usable in the cluster once we provide them) and whether any snapshots already created under Redwood-managed keys will be re-encrypted automatically or need an explicit migration?

If you can include an example audit-export snippet and a draft signed attestation we can share with procurement/legal, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alan

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@finwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, FinWell Security <security@finwell.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data locality attestation and offboarding playbook for dedicated cluster

Alan — following up with the concrete artifacts you requested.

1) Explicit confirmation (one-liner you can copy/paste): 
"FinWell's dedicated cluster will be provisioned and pinned to AWS region us-west-2. Redwood Inference does not enable cross-region replication for Dedicated deployments by default; any cross-region replication requires an explicit replication policy and customer sign-off"

2) BYOK onboarding: Typical onboarding is 1–3 business days after we receive the key metadata and IAM role proof; keys are usable in the cluster once our onboarding job finishes and the role validation completes. Existing snapshots encrypted with Redwood-managed keys are re-encrypted only if you request snapshot re-encryption; otherwise they remain under the original KMS key until rotation/migration. We include key ID mappings in the audit export.

3) Attached artifacts: region_pin_manifest.csv (summary of resource-to-region mapping for a sample tenant), audit-export-20261127.json (sanitized slice showing creation/deletion events), and signed-locality-attestation.pdf (signed by our compliance lead). These are under our standard confidentiality terms.

Action items we will take now: 
- Marissa: run a sanitized audit-export for FinWell and provide an export with tenant-specific IDs (ETA 1 business day).
- Karthik: confirm snapshot retention adjustment options and update the runbook section on re-encryption (ETA 1 business day).
- Irene: share DocuSign link for formal attestation if you'd like the signed PDF to live in your vendor file.

If you want a short walkthrough of the runbook and artifacts, we can schedule a 30-minute call — Marissa and Karthik will join.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: region_pin_manifest.csv, audit-export-20261127.json, signed-locality-attestation.pdf
